summary: Customer C11923 reported an unrecognized online purchase of $131.30 on card C11923-K2 (transaction T3583368). Detector signals reveal a high volume of 84 online transactions within a 48-hour window, with the flagged amount being 3.3x the card's average. Furthermore, the transaction originated from a new mobile device profile (SM-G610F running Chrome for Android). Given the customer's report and the dense cluster of CNP activity from an unrecognized device, this transaction represents unauthorized fraudulent use.
analyst_notes: 84 online transactions within 48h of the flagged one; amount $131.30 is 3.3x this card's average ($39.46); Transaction from a device profile marked New for this account (proxy: not flagged); Customer has 11 prior closed fraud cases on record, indicating recurring vulnerability.; High velocity of online transactions (84 within 48 hours) surrounding the flagged event.
